title: Needs for Fader
description:
Fader wiki: https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Fader

We still to find the Alter to summon him.

We need to get three Bells for the summoning process.

Attack types to focus on:
  - Neutral to Blunt, Slach, Frost, Lightning, and Poison
  - Resistant to Pierce
  - Immune to Fire, Spirit, Chop, Pickaxe

This makes me think:
Ranged: Pick arrows that do statuses like lightning/frost/poison
Magic: Pick the frost or lightning staff for direct damage. Any soul staff should work to do other damage but check the entity damage type
Melee: Focus on Maces/Hammers, Swords, or Lightning/Frost status weapons
